author: agent
objective: Association of daily country-level PM2.5 over the 10-day infection-course lag window with COVID-19 instantaneous case fatality risk.

scientific_invariants.research_question: Association of daily country-level PM2.5 over the 10-day infection-course lag window with COVID-19 instantaneous case fatality risk.
scientific_invariants.target_outcome_and_population: Daily back-projected COVID-19 deaths divided by laboratory-confirmed daily cases in England, Northern Ireland, Scotland and Wales.
scientific_invariants.principal_contrast: Cumulative PM2.5 association over maximum lag 10 days, with figure reference 10 µg/m³.
principal_variants: Model 6 binomial GLMM/DLNM: temperature, sunshine, PM2.5 cross-bases; humidity at exposure date; weekday; country random effect.
Source-substituted bounded binomial country-day model retaining outcome, pollutant, geography, period, and per-10 µg/m³ contrast.

article_evidence.finding: Methods state source, period, daily country pollution averaging, back-projection and binomial DLNM.
Supplement states selected Model 6 and Table S1 country-level PM2.5 summaries.

article_evidence_map.contract_discrepancy: The contract target does not mention article's humidity, weekday, back-projection and DLNM; locked primary target retains them.

execution_design.geographic_representation: Four constituent UK nations represented by GADM administrative polygons for attempted AERIS boundary retrieval; bounded completed analysis uses each nation's documented centroid because the selected Open-Meteo grids are coordinate products.
execution_design.assignment_method: Daily hourly PM2.5 values queried at the four centroids, then arithmetic daily mean and 11-day (lag 0 through 10) rolling mean per nation.
execution_design.source_strategy: Primary attempted source: AERIS/OpenAQ historical monitor boundary batch. Completed fallback: Open-Meteo air-quality archive atmospheric-composition PM2.5 fields, documented as source substitution.
execution_design.exposure_metric: Nation-day PM2.5 concentration in µg/m³; main predictor is the 11-day mean, parameterized per 10 µg/m³.
execution_design.daily_aggregation: Arithmetic mean of hourly PM2.5 values, retaining days with hourly data; 11 daily values required for lag predictor.
execution_design.analysis_aggregation: Nation-day panel joined to daily cases/deaths and daily weather by nation and date.
execution_design.coverage_policy: Report-only. Fit uses complete cases after necessary 11-day lag and fixed 8-day outcome alignment; no data-driven exposure threshold or outcome selection.
execution_design.intended_use: Bounded source-substituted sensitivity analysis, not article effect replication.

evidence.finding: All four nations have hourly-derived daily PM2.5 and complete 11-day lag values over recovered outcome dates.
Fit-ready rows and outcome coverage are retained by nation.
Documents active but non-completing OpenAQ boundary route and the public source recovery choices.

amendments.scientific_justification: The article specifies daily country averages and a 10-day maximum lag. The selected implementation retains daily country-time support and lag scale, while explicitly labeling the coordinate-based modeled PM2.5 source as a substitution.
